column1: # The Magpie native CLI releases. One catalog owns the version every target
# shares and the digest that verifies each asset. The deployment never
# resolves a release at run time: the URL and the SHA-256 below are the pin.
# The Linux and WSL targets are the native CLI the headless deployment runs.
# The macOS targets supply the CLI when the application is absent. The Windows
# adapter owns its own download; this catalog owns every version and digest.
